items.parse_summary: The passive question asks what action the two divisions were commanded to perform. The reduced relative clause “going off duty on the Sabbath” identifies the divisions, with the Sabbath phrase specifying when they go off duty. These divisions receive the command and are understood as the performers of the requested action.

features.quote: the two divisions going off duty on the Sabbath
features.required_operations: Attach “going off duty” to “the two divisions” and “on the Sabbath” to their going off duty, identifying the group whose assignment is requested.
features.reason: The modifier supplies the distinction needed to identify the target divisions.

features.quote: What were the two divisions going off duty on the Sabbath commanded to do?
features.required_operations: Interpret the divisions as recipients of the command and as the understood agents of the action queried by “what ... to do.”
features.reason: The passive construction preserves the necessary command-to-assignment relationship without requiring the respondent to identify the commander.
